bias.zh: 反弹 · 收复 10 日均线，测试 $334

read.en: Broadcom rose 3.9% on Nov 10 to $331.98, trading $316.69–334.67. It is above the 5-day ($312.4) and 10-day ($323.9) and below the 30-day ($339.4), 100-day ($365.7) and 200-day ($367.1); all five averages are falling. MACD has been below its signal since Nov 2, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($340.73), and RSI is 49.
read.zh: 博通 11月10日上涨 3.9%，收于 $331.98，盘中区间 $316.69–334.67。股价位于 5 日（$312.4）和 10 日（$323.9）均线上方，30 日（$339.4）、100 日（$365.7）和 200 日（$367.1）均线下方；五条均线均在下行。MACD 自 11月2日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$340.73），RSI 为 49。

read.en: The rally broke the $319.3–323.1 October lows and the $323.9–326.6 zone (10-day, Nov 3 low), now support. Resistance is $334.1–334.7 (Nov 4 and Nov 10 highs), then $339.4–340.7 (30-day, SAR) and $342.3–343.3 (Sep 3 and Oct 1 lows). Support is $319.3–326.6, then $312.4–316.7 (5-day, Nov 10 low) and $304.3. A close above $334.7 would target $339–343; below $319.3, $312–317.

s.en: October lows ($319.3–321.0); 10-day average $323.9; Nov 3 low $326.6, reclaimed
